name: Get Asset Content
description: Retrieve bytes by any content reference: an asset address, workspace path, file:// root path, or DLFS path. Returned as a hex-encoded Blob with contentType when known. Returns {truncated: true, size} if it exceeds maxSize (default 1MB). Use asset_get for metadata; raw file/DLFS references have content but no asset metadata.

ref.description: Content reference: asset hash/path/DID URL, workspace path, file://<root>/<path> (file:/<root>/<path> is the HTTP-safe equivalent), dlfs/<drive>/<path>, or owner DID /dlfs/ path.

maxSize.description: Maximum content size in bytes (default 1000000). If exceeded, returns truncated: true with the size.

hasContent.description: True if the resolved address has a content payload. An existing metadata-only asset returns exists: true and hasContent: false.

contentType.description: Declared or provider-inferred MIME type, when known

value.description: Content as hex-encoded Blob (0x...). Present when hasContent is true and not truncated.

message.description: Diagnostic explaining why an existing asset has no content payload.

size.description: Content size in bytes (present when truncated)
